note: Cross-game radio manifest. Single source of truth — games load this + radio.js and never change when new stations/tracks are added. Tracks stream from their source URLs (no bundling). Station types: 'broadcast' (live clock — tune in mid-song, everyone on the same second; points at a manifest.json with a program), 'stream' (Polkahole), 'seamless' (the games' own 1-track originals). 10 stations: 2 DSDA Radio broadcast shows (Mental FM 137.7, Z107.7 Classic Rock) + Polkahole + the 3 Machine Elves originals + the 4 ShatterBlock originals. Originals are root-relative (served from /games/<game>/original/) so any game page can reach them. ShatterBlock originals re-synthesized 2026-11-14 with richer synths + live feel (detuned saw leads, sidechained bass, synced echo, FDN reverb, humanized timing/pitch).
